# Telemetry tracking plan

Every analytics event the Host, the Web Client and the mobile app send, under the naming rules of [ADR-0270](adr/0270-telemetry-events-follow-one-tracking-plan.md). The product site keeps its own list in the deepseekbot-site repository under the same rules.

## Naming

- Event: `category:object_action`, lowercase snake_case, a present-tense verb. The same behavior has the same name on every source; `source` tells them apart.
- Categories: `app` `onboarding` `bot_library` `bot_profile` `chat` `search` `tob` `layout` `connect` `remote_host` `pairing` `connection` `activity` `viewer` `model` `storage` `plugin` `im` `share` `notification` `marketplace` `install` `community` `navigation` `demo` `docs` `mobile_beta` `avatar_editor` `campaign`
- Verbs: `view` `open` `close` `enter` `click` `select` `copy` `submit` `send` `create` `update` `delete` `archive` `restore` `install` `enable` `disable` `start` `pause` `resume` `restart` `skip` `complete` `cancel` `fail` `dismiss` `play` `download` `import` `export` `save` `wear` `use` `report`
- Outcomes are one `_complete` event with an `outcome` property, never separate success and failure events.
- Properties: `object_adjective`; booleans start with `is_` or `has_`, counts end with `_count`, bands with `_bucket`, times with `_timestamp`.

## Properties on every event

| Property      | Values                                                                                             |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `source`      | `host` \| `mobile` \| `site` \| `links`                                                            |
| `app_version` | Host package or mobile app version                                                                 |
| `surface`     | `desktop_app` \| `browser` \| `mobile_remote` \| `cli` \| `bot_tool` \| `im` (Host feature events) |

## Host and Web Client

| Event                             | Sent by    | Meaning                                                                                                                              | Properties                                                                                                                                                     |
| --------------------------------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `app:active_day_start`            | Host       | First Human activity of the Host-local calendar day: entering Bot mode, a Human message or an IM message. Basis of DAU, WAU and MAU. | `trigger`: bot_mode_enter \| message \| im_message<br>`surface`: desktop_app \| browser \| mobile_remote \| cli \| bot_tool \| im                              |
| `app:bot_mode_enter`              | Web Client | The Web Client entered Bot mode.                                                                                                     | `surface`: desktop_app \| browser \| mobile_remote \| cli \| bot_tool \| im                                                                                    |
| `app:host_start`                  | Host       | The Host process started with telemetry enabled.                                                                                     | —                                                                                                                                                              |
| `app:usage_report`                | Host       | At most once per 24 hours: Bot count and Sessions and messages since the last report.                                                | `persona_bot_count`: count<br>`session_count`: count<br>`message_count`: count<br>`window_hours`: count                                                        |
| `bot_library:bot_archive`         | Host       | A PersonaBot was paused (archived).                                                                                                  | —                                                                                                                                                              |
| `bot_library:bot_create`          | Host       | A PersonaBot was created (blank, Git, Zip or Marketplace).                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                              |
| `bot_library:bot_delete`          | Host       | A PersonaBot deletion started.                                                                                                       | —                                                                                                                                                              |
| `bot_profile:avatar_update`       | Host       | A PersonaBot's avatar changed.                                                                                                       | —                                                                                                                                                              |
| `bot_profile:banner_update`       | Host       | A PersonaBot's banner changed.                                                                                                       | —                                                                                                                                                              |
| `im:connector_enable`             | Host       | An IM connector was enabled for the first time.                                                                                      | `type`: feishu \| lark \| slack \| discord \| weixin \| other                                                                                                  |
| `marketplace:bot_install`         | Host       | A Marketplace Bot was installed.                                                                                                     | `entry`: list \| hot \| new \| rising \| digest                                                                                                                |
| `marketplace:bot_open`            | Web Client | A Marketplace Bot was opened from a list, row or Digest.                                                                             | `entry`: list \| hot \| new \| rising \| digest<br>`step`: detail \| install<br>`surface`: desktop_app \| browser \| mobile_remote \| cli \| bot_tool \| im    |
| `marketplace:digest_archive_open` | Web Client | The past Digests list was opened.                                                                                                    | `surface`: desktop_app \| browser \| mobile_remote \| cli \| bot_tool \| im                                                                                    |
| `marketplace:digest_open`         | Web Client | A Digest article was opened.                                                                                                         | `entry`: hero \| archive<br>`surface`: desktop_app \| browser \| mobile_remote \| cli \| bot_tool \| im                                                        |
| `marketplace:digest_view`         | Web Client | The daily Digest hero card was shown.                                                                                                | `surface`: desktop_app \| browser \| mobile_remote \| cli \| bot_tool \| im                                                                                    |
| `marketplace:section_view`        | Web Client | The Hot, New and Rising rows were shown.                                                                                             | `surface`: desktop_app \| browser \| mobile_remote \| cli \| bot_tool \| im                                                                                    |
| `onboarding:community_link_click` | Web Client | A community link was opened from the intro.                                                                                          | `target`: github \| discord \| qq<br>`surface`: desktop_app \| browser \| mobile_remote \| cli \| bot_tool \| im                                               |
| `onboarding:intro_complete`       | Web Client | The intro finished with a chosen starter.                                                                                            | `starter`: botPrompt \| firstRequest \| exampleRequest \| own<br>`surface`: desktop_app \| browser \| mobile_remote \| cli \| bot_tool \| im                   |
| `onboarding:intro_dismiss`        | Web Client | The intro closed before its last step.                                                                                               | `step`: welcome \| theme \| model \| community \| start<br>`via`: skip \| close<br>`surface`: desktop_app \| browser \| mobile_remote \| cli \| bot_tool \| im |
| `onboarding:intro_step_view`      | Web Client | An intro step became visible.                                                                                                        | `step`: welcome \| theme \| model \| community \| start<br>`surface`: desktop_app \| browser \| mobile_remote \| cli \| bot_tool \| im                         |
| `onboarding:intro_view`           | Web Client | The first-entry intro opened.                                                                                                        | `surface`: desktop_app \| browser \| mobile_remote \| cli \| bot_tool \| im                                                                                    |
| `onboarding:model_save`           | Web Client | The intro saved a model choice.                                                                                                      | `is_advanced`: boolean<br>`surface`: desktop_app \| browser \| mobile_remote \| cli \| bot_tool \| im                                                          |
| `onboarding:theme_update`         | Web Client | A theme setting changed in the intro.                                                                                                | `setting`: scheme \| preset \| layout \| wallpaper<br>`surface`: desktop_app \| browser \| mobile_remote \| cli \| bot_tool \| im                              |
| `onboarding:tutorial_complete`    | Host       | The tutorial finished.                                                                                                               | —                                                                                                                                                              |
| `onboarding:tutorial_pause`       | Host       | The tutorial was paused.                                                                                                             | —                                                                                                                                                              |
| `onboarding:tutorial_restart`     | Host       | The tutorial restarted from the beginning.                                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                              |
| `onboarding:tutorial_resume`      | Host       | A paused tutorial continued.                                                                                                         | —                                                                                                                                                              |
| `onboarding:tutorial_skip`        | Host       | The tutorial was skipped.                                                                                                            | —                                                                                                                                                              |
| `onboarding:tutorial_start`       | Host       | The getting-started tutorial started.                                                                                                | —                                                                                                                                                              |

Also sent unchanged: `$exception`, `chat:message_feedback_submit`.

## Mobile app

Each event also carries the common mobile context described in [mobile statistics](mobile-statistics.md).

| Event                                 | Properties                                                                            |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `app:app_open`                        | `launch_kind`, `paired_host_count_bucket`                                             |
| `bot_library:create_attempt_complete` | `kind`, `phase`, `attempt_id`, `outcome`, `reason`, `duration_bucket`                 |
| `bot_library:create_attempt_start`    | `kind`, `phase`, `attempt_id`                                                         |
| `connection:attempt_complete`         | `trigger`, `outcome`, `reason`, `attempt_id`, `duration_bucket`, `retry_count_bucket` |
| `onboarding:activation_step_complete` | `step`, `channel_kind`                                                                |
| `pairing:attempt_complete`            | `method`, `attempt_id`, `outcome`, `reason`, `duration_bucket`                        |
| `pairing:attempt_start`               | `method`, `attempt_id`                                                                |
